title: 1903 yil: birinchi parvoz atigi 12 soniya davom etgan

scenes.keywords: man running on beach toward horizon cinematic

scenes.text: Aka-uka Raytlar velosiped ustaxonasi egalari edi.
1903 yil 17 dekabrda ular o'zlari yasagan samolyotda havoga ko'tarildi.
scenes.keywords: people pushing small airplane on sand dunes

scenes.text: Birinchi parvoz atigi 12 soniya davom etdi va taxminan 37 metrga yetdi.
scenes.keywords: men running beside glider takeoff wind

scenes.text: O'sha kuni to'rtinchi parvoz 59 soniyaga cho'zildi.
scenes.keywords: pilot flying small plane over coast

scenes.text: Sen qaysi birini tanlaysan: kichik boshlashnimi yoki kutib turishnimi?
scenes.keywords: young woman starting run at dawn

description: 1903 yil 17 dekabrda aka-uka Raytlar Kitti-Xok yaqinida birinchi boshqariladigan motorli parvozni amalga oshirdi. Birinchi parvoz 12 soniya, taxminan 37 metr davom etdi; o'sha kuni to'rtinchi parvoz 59 soniyaga cho'zildi.
source: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum: The 1903 Wright Flyer (first flight 17 Dec 1903, 12 seconds, 120 ft / 36.6 m; fourth flight 59 seconds, 852 ft), https://airandspace.si.edu/collection-objects/1903-wright-flyer/nasm_A19610048000 ; Encyclopaedia Britannica: Wright brothers (bicycle shop in Dayton, Ohio).
